item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 27/Jan/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a dry northeast monsoon, the weather will become fine over Guangdong today. It will be cold in the morning and at night over the region during the weekend to early next week. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. A fresh to strong easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week. It will be cloudier and temperatures will rise gradually over the region.

Date/Month: 27/01 (Friday)
Wind: North force 4 to 5, force 6 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: Mainly cloudy and dry. Sunny periods during the day. Temperatures falling appreciably.
Temp range: 13 - 17 C
R.H. range: 40 - 80 per Cent
PSR: Low
